record.name: Human
record.narrative: Humans are the most adaptable and widespread species in the galaxy, found on countless worlds and in every major faction. Their versatility, ambition, and drive for exploration have made them a dominant force in galactic civilization. Humans excel at learning new skills and adapting to different environments, making them natural diplomats, traders, and adventurers.
record.flavor_text: 'The Force is strong in my family. My father has it. I have it. And... my sister has it.' - Luke Skywalker
record.cultural_significance: Humans are viewed as ambitious, adaptable, and sometimes reckless by other species. They are known for their short lifespans but intense drive to achieve greatness in that time.
record.description: Humans are a versatile species with no single defining characteristic, making them adaptable to any role or environment. Their diversity and ambition have led them to colonize worlds across the galaxy.
record.origin_story: Humans originated on the planet Coruscant and quickly spread throughout the galaxy, establishing colonies and trade routes. Their adaptability and ambition made them natural leaders and explorers.

innate_traits.name: Versatility
innate_traits.narrative: Humans are naturally adaptable and quick to learn new skills.

parameters.description: Choose one additional skill proficiency, tool proficiency, or language

innate_traits.name: Determination
innate_traits.narrative: Humans possess an inner drive that pushes them to excel beyond their natural limits.

parameters.description: Once per long rest, you can reroll a failed saving throw

record.cultural_notes: Humans are known for their ambition, adaptability, and drive to explore. They value individual achievement and personal freedom.
languages: One additional language of your choice

connections.narrative: Humans were founding members of the Galactic Republic and have been central to its governance throughout its history.
connections.mechanical_benefit: Humans gain advantage on Charisma checks when dealing with Republic officials

connections.narrative: Humans dominated the Galactic Empire, with most high-ranking positions held by humans.
connections.mechanical_benefit: Humans gain advantage on Charisma checks when dealing with Imperial officials

connections.narrative: Humans' versatility and determination make them natural Jedi Guardians.
connections.mechanical_benefit: Human Guardians gain +1 to their Force point maximum

connections.narrative: Humans' adaptability and diplomatic nature make them excellent Jedi Consulars.
connections.mechanical_benefit: Human Consulars gain advantage on Persuasion checks

iconic_examples: Luke Skywalker - The farm boy who became a Jedi Knight
Leia Organa - The princess who became a general
Han Solo - The smuggler who became a hero
Obi-Wan Kenobi - The wise Jedi Master

llm_guidance.roleplay_guidance: Humans are versatile and adaptable. They can fit into any role or background, but they often have a driving ambition or personal goal that motivates them. They're known for their determination and ability to overcome obstacles through sheer willpower.
narrative_hooks: A human character discovers they have Force sensitivity
A human character must choose between personal gain and helping others
A human character seeks to prove themselves in a galaxy of more exotic species
A human character carries the weight of their family's legacy
llm_guidance.social_dynamics: Humans are generally well-received by other species due to their adaptability and diplomatic nature. However, some species view them as overly ambitious or reckless.
common_motivations: Achieving mastery in their chosen field
Making a difference in the galaxy
llm_guidance.species_development: Human characters often grow through overcoming personal challenges and learning to balance their ambition with wisdom. They excel at adapting to new situations and learning from their mistakes.

image_generation.base_prompt: A detailed portrait of a human character in the Star Wars universe. The character should have realistic human features with diverse skin tones, hair colors, and eye colors. They should be dressed in appropriate Star Wars attire for their role - whether that's Jedi robes, Imperial uniforms, Rebel gear, or civilian clothing. The background should reflect their environment and the era they're from. The mood should capture the character's personality and role in the galaxy.
